interaction_target: live-room layout — channel rail, stage, side track, theatre mode
borrowed: behaviour only, and Mobilizon’s own Tailwind build from its tailwind.config.cjs plus the scoped stylesheet of DateCalendarIcon.vue. No ontology, no backend.
shape: one page over live Aurekai endpoints; every pane names the path that produced it
interaction: rail of rooms on now, ordered room -> programme -> act -> way out
the stage carries the room's own status line at stage size
a fill meter parsed from the room's capacity sentence, labelled reported
a room that described its capacity in words gets a described meter, not a number
About / Also tonight / Schedule tabs; the schedule is the gated one
'also tonight' is derived from records naming each other, not from a category
the track polls /events every 20s, pins to the newest and pauses when you scroll up
theatre mode collapses both rails; Escape leaves it
arrow keys change room, T theatre, F follow, R refresh
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — night-events is gated, and the tab says so while the rest of the page keeps reading
empty (200, no records) — an empty projection, named as one
failed (other) — nothing rendered rather than stale or invented
actions: offered, never submitted; FOLLOW is stored in this browser and the room is not told

observed_2026_09_04.night-live: 5 records — 2 rooms with a capacity note, 1 programme, 1 act, 1 way out

forbidden_inference: a stage -> a video stream; this room publishes status, and the surface says so on the stage itself
a capacity note -> current occupancy; it is what the room published, at the time it published it
a fill meter -> a count; it is parsed from the room's own sentence and labelled reported
watching a room -> a plan, an obligation, or anybody expecting you
the track -> the room's chat; it is the estate's occurrence feed and nobody in it is in the room
a follow -> a relationship; it is stored in this browser and the room is not told

requires_authority: participation is an effect owned by the room; this surface offers it and does not carry it

lineage.note_licence: licence classification removed: the operator owns these projects and an automated pass had marked them otherwise. Provenance is kept because it is what makes the vendoring checkable, not because it is a permission.
